sentences.text: Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The accused/applicant seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 174/2025 of PS Sangam Vihar for offence under Section 376 IPC and Section 6/21 POCSO Act.

It is alleged that the prosecutrix of minor age after being raped by the accused/applicant, who was a friend of her maternal uncle,
conceived and gave birth to a girl child.
3. Learned APP accepts notice and seeks and is allowed two weeks to file Status Report.

4. Relist on 22.05.2025.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J MAY 7, 2025/DR
